data.title: Data & backups
data.subtitle: Back up the shop, restore from a backup, and import the old MS Access data
data.jobRunningHint: This runs in the background — you can leave this page and come back.
data.backupDesc: Creates a .zip with everything in this store (products, members, sales, receivables, receipts, stock, dividends, users and settings)
data.restoreDesc: Load a backup back into the store — for moving to another server or recovering lost data
data.restoreWarning: A restore overwrites the current data. Always take a fresh backup first, and do this outside trading hours.
data.replaceLabel: Clear the store's current data first (recommended)
data.profileLabel: Also restore the shop profile (name, address, receipt text)
data.confirmRestoreReplace: Every row of this store is deleted and replaced with the archive. This cannot be undone.
data.confirmRestoreMerge: Only rows that do not exist yet are added; existing rows are left untouched.
data.understood: I understand and want to continue
data.legacyTitle: Import from the old system (MS Access)
data.legacyDesc: Move products, members, sales, receivables and dividends from the old POS program into this system
data.legacyStep1: On the computer holding database.mdb, download extract.ps1, open PowerShell in that folder and run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File extract.ps1 -Mdb D:/pos/database.mdb -Password (old database password) -Out dump -Zip
data.legacyStep2: The script produces dump.zip — upload that file here.
data.legacyStep3: Run "Dry run" first to check the numbers (nothing is saved). If they match the old system, run the real import.
data.confirmImportBody: Legacy rows are added to this store. Anything already imported is skipped, so running it again is safe.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.subtitle: Ask about your shop's data in plain language; the assistant turns it into a read-only query and summarises the answer
ai.askHint: For example: how much did we sell this month, or the ten best sellers
ai.placeholder: Type a question about the shop's data and press Enter
examples: How much did we sell this month?
ai.disabledTitle: The AI assistant is not enabled
ai.disabledBody: Set AI_ENABLED=true and make sure the server can reach the T-LLM gateway (see docs/DEPLOY.md section 7). This page works as soon as that is done — nothing else to change.
ai.gatewayDown: Enabled, but the T-LLM gateway at {url} cannot be reached — check the network or the gateway whitelist
ai.whenEnabled: Once enabled you can ask in plain language, e.g. "how does this week compare with last week?". The assistant writes a read-only query (SELECT only, capped at 200 rows, restricted to your own store), runs it and explains the result alongside the query it used.
